initial:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a high-resolution square ARKODIA world terrain concept for human review, true TOP VIEW, camera exactly vertically down, north up. Reference-guided new painting expanding the current Frozen Frontier into the surrounding world. Input 1 placement map is the authoritative CENTRAL LAYOUT (ignore its isometric camera and labels); input 2 current gameplay is authoritative snowy materials/ruins; input 3 approved gate is stone style reference; input 4 earlier siteplan ONLY supplies peripheral biome locations, NOT its green center or perspective.
Preserve recognizable central Frozen Frontier: a large square limestone paved Stronghold courtyard enclosed by continuous ramparts and a twin-tower south gate; sparse snowy pine groves north-west and north-east behind it; south of court a readable open snowy gate meadow and worn branching flagstone trails; ruined gateway on main south road; small snowy shrine west of road; ruined temple colonnade on rectangular podium and two ruined houses farther south/southwest; broken watchtower in its small walled yard east of road; sparse east woods and southern frozen steppe. Keep these spatial relationships and open clearing, no invented central replacement castle/city. Central snowy layout occupies middle ~40 percent of image, readable architecture from directly above, roofless ruin floor plans, tree crowns, wall tops; no side-on towers.
Expand organically outward: WEST icy pine foothills, fractured glacier ravine, frozen falls and small crystalline cathedral; NORTH charcoal basalt, obsidian spires, volcanic caldera with restrained ember fissures; EAST muted ochre/olive wind-scoured plains, one giant weathered Worldtree canopy, stone arch ruins and herd watering hole; SOUTH thawing dirty bog, black dead woodland, sunken necropolis, ruined cemetery and giant rib monument visible as overhead curved bones. Wide gradual transition belts: geothermal snow NW, dry volcanic grass NE, thawing bog SW, old grassland graves SE. Connect regions with legible winding routes and subtle waterways. Rugged scarred terrain, weathered gray-beige limestone, dirty ivory snow, slate blue shadows, desaturated gray-green marsh, charcoal roots, restrained amber life accents and rust-red lava. Dark gritty painterly fantasy, cold somber atmosphere, broad masses, detailed yet navigable quiet terrain. Avoid saturated cyan, lime green, cheerful gold, excessive fog or tiny busy ornament.
Strict orthographic overhead cartographic painting: no horizon, no sky, no visible vertical building facades, no isometric/oblique/perspective camera, no diorama cutaway. No grid, HUD, encounter markers or decorative border. Sparse small English cartographic labels only: FROZEN FRONTIER at center, STRONGHOLD within courtyard, ICE west, MAGMA north, PLAINS east, UNDEAD south. Small N arrow and footer CONCEPT — FOR REVIEW ONLY. This is illustrative concept geography, not an exact tile survey.
cameraCorrection:
Edit this world map ONLY to correct camera projection and restrain color. Repaint the entire image as a STRICT VERTICAL NADIR TOP-DOWN terrain map. Camera looks exactly straight down at ground at 90 degrees, like an orthographic satellite image. All structures must show roofs, wall tops and floor footprints only, NEVER vertical facades. Trees must show round irregular crowns from above, NEVER upright tree silhouettes. Volcano must be a crater seen as concentric irregular rings with lava in its bowl, NOT a mountain elevation drawing. Ice cliffs become overhead fissures and contour shelves, no cascading vertical walls. Rib monument becomes parallel curved bones from above. Remove any remaining isometric or bird's-eye angle. This camera constraint takes priority over all reference imagery.
Preserve current composition and positions exactly: snowy Frozen Frontier center; square Stronghold court with south gate; two pine groves north; snowy shrine southwest, broken gateway south, temple and ruined houses further southwest/south, watchtower southeast, branching stone paths and two irregular clearings. Preserve four peripheral biome footprints: magma north, ice west, muted ochre plains east with Worldtree crown, undead marsh south with necropolis and cemetery. Keep English labels and small north arrow. Dark gritty painterly fantasy map with dirty snow, weathered limestone, muted gray-green marsh instead of vivid teal, muted ochre plains instead of gold. Detailed and legible harsh rugged terrain. No horizon, perspective, visible vertical architecture, cartoon style, grid, UI or replacement central city. Footer CONCEPT — FOR REVIEW ONLY.
